title: OpResult
description:
The result of a completed operation.

Clause: Core 2, Core A2-1, Core AM-3.

OpOutput.description:
The `Ok` value of a completion: the `Ok` column of the A2-1 table.

Clause: Core A2-1, Core A3-3.

SessionRecord.description:
The record of `get(id)`.

Clause: Core LC-9, Core AD-4, Core A2-1, Core A2-6.

worker_features.description: The features of the session's worker. Absent for a session with no worker.

SessionId.description:
The id of a session, chosen by the host (at most `max_session_id_bytes` bytes).

Clause: Core 3, Core ID-1.

SessionState.description:
The state of a session as `get` and `SessionState` report it.

Clause: Core 3, Core A2-1, Core LC-9.

Exit.description:
How a payload ended: death by a signal has `code: None` and `signal: Some(n)`.

Clause: Core 3, Core EV-4, Core A2-1.

anyOf.description:
Why a session payload ended. A host maps an unknown value to `Other`.

Clause: Core A2-1, Core EV-4.

Why a session or a service is `Lost`.

Clause: Core AD-2, Core SV-8, Core A2-5.

Size.description:
A terminal size.

Clause: Core 3, Core A2-1, Core SZ-1.

CellPx.description:
The pixel size of one cell, from 1.

Clause: Core 3, Core EV-8a.

Feature.description:
One feature name, spelled as in the A2-6 table.

Clause: Core A2-6, Core A3-3, Core SV-4, Core SV-8, Core DP-12, Core ST-6b.

SessionEnd.description:
How a session ended, as `Stop` completes: `Exited(Exit)` or `Lost(reason)`.

Clause: Core A2-1, Core LC-5.

Screen.description:
The result of `ReadScreen`.

Clause: Core ST-2, Core A2-1.

ModelRev.description:
An opaque token: equality only.

Clause: Core ST-1, Core IN-10.

Cursor.description:
The result of `ReadCursor`. `row` and `col` are zero-based cells.

Clause: Core ST-3, Core A2-1.

Modes.description:
The result of `ReadModeFlags`.

Clause: Core ST-1, Core A2-1.

ModeFlags.description:
The session's modes on the route: `ModeFlags` of A.6, which is Core 5.1A verbatim.

Clause: Codec A.6, TS-4d.

kitty_flags.description: A bitset of the kitty flags 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16.

other_modes.description: Modes outside this list. A receiver ignores names it does not know.

Capture.description:
The result of `CaptureSnapshot`.

Clause: Core ST-6, Core A2-1.

CaptureId.description:
The id of a capture, minted by Core.

Clause: Core 3, Core ST-6, Core ID-1.

Facts.description:
The result of `ReadFacts`: all facts taken at one point in the worker's ordering.

Clause: Core ST-7.

FactsCursor.description:
The cursor as `ReadFacts` reports it.

Clause: Core ST-7.

InputFacts.description:
The input part of `Facts`.

Clause: Core ST-7.

ClientFacts.description:
The client part of the input facts.

Clause: Core ST-7, Core IN-10.

InputRev.description:
An opaque token: equality only.

Clause: Core IN-10, Core ST-4.

HostFacts.description:
The host side of the input facts.

Clause: Core ST-7, Core IN-10.

InputRecordEntry.description:
One entry of `input_records`: a record or the status update of an earlier record.

Clause: Core ST-7.

InputRecord.description:
A record of one PTY input, created at the worker's receipt of it.

Clause: Core ST-7.

shifted_key.description: The original key fields of 5.1A, kept as sent.

require_bracketed.description: The `Paste` field of IN-8, kept as sent.

pty_bytes.description: Null while the record is pending (ST-7).

InputCursor.description:
An opaque cursor: equality and `after` only.

Clause: Core ST-7.

InputSource.description:
The source of an input record.

Clause: Core ST-7, Core IN-4.

InputKind.description:
The kind of an input record.

Clause: Core ST-7.

KeyEvent.description:
The `event` of a key input.

Clause: Codec A.5, Core 5.1A.

Key.description:
A key: `{"named": <NamedKey>}` or `{"char": "<one scalar>"}`.

Clause: Codec A.5, Core 5.1A.

Modifier.description:
A modifier of Core 5.1A.

Clause: Codec A.5, Core 5.1A.

MouseInput.description:
A semantic mouse event (5.1A `Mouse`).

Clause: Core IN-9, Core 5.1A.

MouseAction.description:
The `action` of a mouse input.

Clause: Codec A.5, Core 5.1A.

MouseButton.description:
The `button` of a mouse input. `action` is `wheel` exactly when the button is a `wheel_*` value.

Clause: Codec A.5, Core 5.1A.

InputRecordState.description:
The state of an input record. `pending` has no byte count yet.

Clause: Core ST-7.

NotWrittenReason.description:
Why a write is a certain zero.

Clause: Core IN-2, Core A2-2, Core IN-7, Core IN-8, Core IN-10.

anyOf.description:
What an event had no encoding for. A receiver treats an unknown value as opaque.

Clause: Core A2-2, Core 5.1A.

InputStatusUpdate.description:
The status update of an earlier record.

Clause: Core ST-7.

ResizeResult.description:
The result of `Resize`: the size applied, or the later resize that replaced it.

Clause: Core SZ-3, Core A2-1.

OpId.description:
The id of an operation.

Clause: Core 3, Core ID-1, Core ID-2.

InputResult.description:
The completion value of `WriteInput`. `detail` has no compatibility promise.

Clause: Core IN-2, Core A2-2, Core IN-9.

WriteOutcome.description:
The outcome of one write. The counts are exact for every outcome except `Unknown`.

Clause: Core IN-2, Core A2-2.

SpawnReport.description:
The completion value of `SpawnService`.

Clause: Core SV-4, Core A2-1.

Bound.description:
An OS bound of a service (SV-4). The names match the `bound:` features.

Clause: Core SV-4, Core A2-6.

ServiceEnd.description:
The completion of `StopService`: the recorded exit, or the `Lost` state's own payload.

Clause: Core A16-1, Core A16-2.

ServiceExit.description:
The `Exited` payload of a service.

Clause: Core SV-5, Core A2-1.

anyOf.description:
Why a service exited. A host maps an unknown cause to `Other`.

Clause: Core SV-5, Core A2-1.

RemoveReport.description:
The `Ok` value of `Remove`.

Clause: Core A6-3, Core A6-4.

UploadsOutcome.description:
The outcome of the upload cleanup at `Remove`.

Clause: Core A6-3.

oneOf.description: The cleanup completed and every uploaded file is gone, or there were none.

NotDeleted.description:
Why uploaded files are still on disk after a `Remove`. A path list belongs to `DeleteFailed` only, so no path is ever claimed for
`OutcomeUnknown`.

Clause: Core A6-3.

oneOf.description: The cleanup completed. `paths` are exactly the files that could not be deleted.
The cleanup did not complete with a trusted result. Any number of files may remain.

CoreError.description:
An error of Core.

Clause: Core 3, Core 9.3.

ErrorCode.description:
Every error code of Core.

Clause: Core 9.3 (the table), Core A2-1, Core A2-10 (the removed and added codes).

Clause: Core 9.3, Core A2-1, Core A2-10.

oneOf.description: Clause: Core A7-1, Core A15-1. `field` names the refused input (for example `route_limits.max_frame_bytes`, or `text`); it is absent when no clause names one.

anyOf.description:
Why `Start` failed. A host maps an unknown reason to `Other`.

Clause: Core A2-1, Core LC-4, Core AD-7.

The typed reason of an `Unsupported` that the contract names for `attach`.

Clause: Core OU-1.

ErrorCategory.description:
The category of an error code (9.3).

Clause: Core 9.3.
